algorithm: {The proposed algorithm is a simple 1+1 Evolution Strategy (ES) with adaptive step size and polynomial mutation, which iteratively generates new candidate solutions by perturbing the best solution found so far using a step size that adapts based on the progress of the search process.}

{The proposed algorithm is a combination of Simulated Annealing (SA) and Random Search (RS), with an adaptive cooling schedule that balances exploration and exploitation to efficiently minimize the Rosenbrock function.}
